admitted_requests: Admit mode creates canonical pending audit requests only up to max_requests_per_cycle.
known_limitations: The repository CLI requires PYTHONPATH=src in this container because the package is not installed into the active Python environment.
Historical max_age_hours is documented as a policy default; current deterministic tests exercise candidate and request limits.
merge_authority_equivalent: Chief Architect review required before merge.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: Not applicable in local validation environment; PR is created by make_pr tool after commit.
quarantined_records: Default first-run consolidation mode is quarantine; canonical candidates are not admitted unless explicitly requested.
reconciled_existing_requests: reconcile-requests retains one active request per group and marks weaker active requests superseded with history.
summary: Implemented merge discovery consolidation, default quarantine backfill control, explicit admission, existing request reconciliation, runtime and Office metrics, CLI commands, tests, and documentation.
superseded_records: Weaker discoveries are marked superseded and linked through superseded_by/canonical_discovery_id.
